info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

parcels.desc: This approximately 45 ft long * 40 ft wide old church is on the south side of Brutus Rd just east of Ayr Rd, and is in reasonably good condition; with a newer furnace and pressure tank. Looks like 200 Amp service but the outside line/post is damaged, possibly due to last year's ice storm. Overall, the exterior is rougher than the interior. This wooded ~0.67 acre is on the SE corner of N Conway Rd and Tower Rd, both 2-tracks in this area. Nice hardwoods on the gently rolling property, surrounded by state land. A great place to get (far) away from people! This one is ~ 1 acre on the north side of Serva Rd, about 1/2 mile east of Welscheimer Rd. Nice hardwoods on the flat property adjoining state land. Power appears to be almost 1/2 mile away. Interested bidders should contact the local government and/or association regarding possible development or use restrictions like minimum sq footage requirement, utilities, etc.

~95 ft frontage on Cedardale to the NW, ~145 ft median depth. ~0.3 acres. Irregular shape, off a cul-de-sac in the Orchard Ridge Association just east of Petoskey center. Paved driveway leads to a good looking single story with attached garage. Parcel is overgrown in the rear, with some fallout from a recent ice storm evident.
